## About

Abiral Acharya is an SEO consultant based in Birtamode, Jhapa, Nepal. He helps businesses, startups, websites, and personal brands improve organic search visibility through technical SEO, content optimization, keyword research, local SEO, authority building, and search-focused website optimization.

His approach combines SEO strategy with a technical understanding of websites, including crawlability, indexing, site structure, structured data, performance, Core Web Vitals, and security.

Abiral currently works as an SEO Consultant at GreenHub Digital and is pursuing a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) at Mechi Multiple Campus (Tribhuvan University).

Primary location:
- Birtamode, Jhapa, Nepal

Service coverage:
- Nepal (including Kathmandu and Jhapa)
- Nepal-based businesses and websites
- Remote clients and international websites

## Services

Core service areas:

- Technical SEO — audits, crawlability analysis, indexing coverage, canonicalization, XML sitemaps, robots.txt analysis, redirect management, structured data, Core Web Vitals, site speed, error diagnosis, site architecture improvements.
- On-Page SEO — search intent analysis, keyword mapping, title and meta description optimization, heading structure, semantic HTML, content optimization, internal linking, image optimization, entity and topical relevance.
- Off-Page SEO — white-hat link building, brand mentions, digital PR, authority building.
- Local SEO — Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword research, NAP consistency, local landing pages, local citations, geo-targeted content, Google Maps visibility.
- Keyword Research — keyword discovery, search intent classification, competitor analysis, keyword difficulty, long-tail and question-based keywords, semantic keyword mapping, keyword-to-page mapping, content cluster planning, local keyword research.
- SEO Audits — full technical, on-page, and content audits with prioritized actionable roadmaps.
- AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) — direct-answer content, conversational search optimization, question-based structures, entity optimization, semantic relationships, machine-readable information architecture.
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — improving retrieval and reference ability for AI-powered and generative search experiences (visibility not guaranteed by search engines or AI systems).
- Structured Data / Schema — schema implementation for entities, articles, local business, FAQs, and rich results readiness.
- E-E-A-T optimization, topical authority, semantic SEO, crawlability and indexation, SEO analytics and reporting, WordPress SEO, and SEO-focused WordPress development.

Note: AEO/GEO work improves how information can be understood, retrieved, referenced, or cited in AI-powered search, but AI visibility is not guaranteed — search engines and AI systems independently decide which sources they display, cite, summarize, or recommend.
